title: Corelib 67-target matrix and release evidence
body:
The 2026-08-11 reconstruction covered every target in the then-current 61-target manifest at 38 passing / 23 failing, superseding the dated 20/61 baseline. The run used root `0733294b`, compiler `8bbdb593`, Corelib `9ca06db4`, and deterministic EOF; no target hung. Corelib `ce8bc7f` later added six production targets, making 67 the authoritative current release denominator. The historical 23 failures collapsed to generic specialization/ABI facts across 14 targets plus focused generation-bound syntax result/storage, scalar-payload enum-layout, and `Concurrency.Yield` leaves. Completion requires one unfiltered source-tip 67/67 process under five minutes with exact revisions and a retained report.

**Research:** `docs/superpowers/reports/2026-08-11-cyb-188-corelib-closure-graph.md` on `research/0-4-corelib-failure-graph` at `04bf6b77`.

**Linear:** [CYB-181](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-181/v04-recover-authoritative-61-target-corelib-matrix-and-bounded-harness)

subtasks.text: Record fresh 61-target current-tip baseline (38 pass / 23 fail)
Bind canonical Corelib gate stdin to deterministic EOF
Recover shared semantic ABI, enum-layout, and generic failure clusters
Record fresh 67/67 source-tip matrix with exact revisions and retained report
